read_gap.handling: Archive No-Read Fence preserved. Fresh MISSION_STATE and exact-current v1/v2/v2.1 executable/tests/contracts control this review; no broad archive inference was used.

material_delta.finding: The required durable_progress_per_wake speed metric can improve without any real throughput gain if the candidate changes wake/coalescing cadence or the definition of an eligible wake. A controller that emits the same durable progress but receives fewer counted wakes can appear faster while verified_closure_per_hour, cycle latency or recovery latency remain unchanged or worsen. The current v2.1 contract names the metric but does not bind its numerator/denominator to a precommitted scheduler/runtime definition or forbid candidate-dependent denominator changes.
material_delta.required_change: For paired speed claims, precommit a canonical eligible-wake definition and scheduler cadence/policy, bind both numerator and denominator to durable runtime records, and either freeze cadence between baseline/candidate or normalize by matched wall-clock/workload exposure. Report durable_progress_per_wake only together with verified_closure_per_hour, cycle_completion_latency, rework_ratio and recovery_latency. A ratio-only gain caused by fewer counted wakes is not speedup.

agreements: DURABLE_PROGRESS and ADVERSARIAL_DEFECT_FOUND are operational-only and cannot become verified Experience.
HEARTBEAT, POLL, RETRY, WAIT, SCHEDULER_WAKE, reconnect, window age and runtime uptime are not Experience.
The anti-thrash branch does not block immediate safety/recovery downshifts because it only suppresses selected_n > current_n.
formal_mutation_allowed remains false; P_base, Identity, Personality and Governance remain outside this candidate's write authority.
GEARBOX_V2_1_CONTRACT correctly states speed improvement is NOT_YET_STATISTICALLY_ESTABLISHED.
Gearbox v1 verified baseline and Step009 Heartbeat verified foundation remain preserved.

disagreements.finding: secretary_signal_fresh and authority_conflict are caller-supplied facts, so stale secretary freshness can be forged.
disagreements.required_change: Use replay-resistant SecretarySignalEnvelope plus trusted authority comparison; unbound/non-bool controls fail closed.

disagreements.finding: authority_conflict only changes secretary_level to UNKNOWN; it does not import/enforce the fresh authority decision. Caller-supplied permissive v2 kwargs can still select a higher gear even when fresh authority actually requires G1/recovery.
disagreements.required_change: Consume a trusted AuthorityDecisionEnvelope/exact authority snapshot and project the trusted safe decision or fail closed.

disagreements.finding: secretary_signal_fresh and authority_conflict lack strict bool validation; truthy strings such as 'false' change control flow.
disagreements.required_change: Reject non-bool values fail-closed; then replace free booleans with evidence-bound controls.

disagreements.finding: current_gear is caller-supplied and directly controls v2 hysteresis and v2.1 anti-thrash exposure.
disagreements.required_change: Derive current gear from canonical monotonic runtime/shift state bound to installation/runtime identity and policy hash.

disagreements.finding: verification_stage=C_VERIFIED is a free caller string that can remove the unverified G4 cap without exact C evidence.
disagreements.required_change: Derive stage from trusted verifier/acceptance receipts bound to exact evidence, mission/step/scope, verifier identity, freshness/revocation and installation/workspace identity.

disagreements.finding: verified Experience still depends on event kind plus a free independently_verified flag rather than exact evidence hash and trusted C/independent-verifier receipt.
disagreements.required_change: Require canonical evidence/event identity plus trusted verifier receipt and durable acceptance record.

disagreements.finding: aggregate_experience_events and select_gear_v2_1 use bool(...) on verification flags, so nonempty values such as 'false' or '0' become True.
disagreements.required_change: Strict bool fail-closed plus verifier authority binding.

disagreements.finding: event_id-only dedupe permits identical canonical evidence to be replayed under new IDs.
disagreements.required_change: Deduplicate by sealed evidence lineage/acceptance identity, not caller event_id alone.

disagreements.finding: aggregate_experience_events creates seen=set() per invocation, so identical IDs can be re-credited across polling, restart or rollback.
disagreements.required_change: Durable replay-resistant accepted-event registry protected against rollback.

disagreements.finding: the same event_id is not immutably bound to kind/evidence/verifier identity across runs.
disagreements.required_change: First acceptance seals EventIdentity; same-ID/different-binding is IDENTITY_CONFLICT; exact replay is a no-op.

disagreements.finding: select_gear_v2_1 recomputes verified credit directly from caller event fields rather than consuming ledger-authorized acceptance.
disagreements.required_change: Single AcceptedExperienceReceipt authority path; receipt-less decisions emit zero verified credit.

disagreements.finding: select_gear_v2_1 also recomputes operational progress from caller event_kind, so decision-call frequency can fabricate throughput.
disagreements.required_change: Operational progress must use the same durable accepted-event receipt path; decision calls never create progress.

disagreements.finding: recent_shift_rate_ratio is caller-supplied and can arbitrarily activate or bypass anti-thrash.
disagreements.required_change: Derive from canonical append-only shift ledger with numerator, denominator, observation window, sample count, runtime identity and policy hash.

disagreements.finding: ratio >= 0.50 has no minimum support/window/confidence semantics; 1/1 or 2/3 can trigger a hold.
disagreements.required_change: Precommit minimum support, window, uncertainty and release semantics; numeric thresholds remain TEST_REQUIRED.

disagreements.finding: anti-thrash can indefinitely suppress a safe upshift and make gear_shift_rate look better while cycle/closure/recovery performance degrades.
disagreements.required_change: Bound hold/cooldown/release and require paired performance non-regression.

disagreements.finding: verified_progress_density is caller-supplied and currently reason-only; wiring it into behavior later would create a self-reinforcement risk.
disagreements.required_change: Keep observational until independently derived over precommitted denominator/window and causal anti-self-reinforcement tests pass.

disagreements.finding: 5/4/3 verified credits and operational 1 are engineering heuristics, not calibrated interval-scale measurements of capability, truth, Trust or personality.
disagreements.required_change: Never use aggregate credit score as capability truth, Trust, Identity/Personality evidence or promotion threshold; weights remain TEST_REQUIRED.
Matched workload paired baseline must report durable_progress_per_wake, verified_closure_per_hour, cycle_completion_latency, rework_ratio and recovery_latency with equal-or-better verification/risk.

disagreements.finding: durable_progress_per_wake can be inflated by changing scheduler cadence or counted-wake semantics instead of improving work throughput.
disagreements.required_change: Freeze/precommit eligible-wake definition and scheduler policy, bind denominator to durable runtime records, and reject ratio-only gains that do not reproduce in wall-clock closure/latency metrics.

statistical_risks: Caller-forged secretary freshness or authority conflict causes exposure misclassification and invalid fresh-vs-stale comparisons.
A conflict bit without an authority snapshot can falsely attribute fallback routing to fresh authority.
Caller-forged current_gear changes hysteresis exposure and biases gear-shift, latency and throughput comparisons.
Caller-forged C_VERIFIED changes reachable gear distribution and confounds speed with verification-stage misclassification.
Transient event-id dedupe permits longitudinal credit inflation across polling/restarts/rollback and semantic rebinding.
Repeated decision calls can inflate verified or operational deltas without new durable acceptance.
Caller-controlled shift-rate provenance permits anti-thrash activation/bypass bias; tiny samples create high-variance false triggers.
Anti-thrash can reduce gear_shift_rate while worsening cycle latency, verified closure throughput or recovery latency.
verified_progress_density has no bound denominator/window/independence and could become self-reinforcing if later connected to routing.
5/4/3 credits are ordinal engineering heuristics, not calibrated capability measurements.
durable_progress_per_wake is denominator-sensitive; candidate-dependent wake coalescing can create apparent gains without more progress per hour.
Unmatched speed comparisons are confounded by workload mix, verifier availability, incident rate, routing state and runtime conditions.
proposed_tests: GB21-FRESHNESS-FORGE-001: stale RED/ORANGE with caller-forged freshness cannot affect gear without trusted freshness evidence.
GB21-AUTHORITY-CONFLICT-002: newer canonical authority wins even if caller sets authority_conflict=false.
GB21-AUTHORITY-DECISION-PROJECTION-028: trusted authority=G1/recovery plus permissive caller fallback still produces G1.
GB21-AUTHORITY-ENVELOPE-REPLAY-029: stale/revoked/cross-mission/cross-installation authority envelopes reject fail-closed.
GB21-CURRENT-GEAR-FORGE-026: canonical runtime G1 defeats caller-reported G5 for hysteresis/anti-thrash.
GB21-VERIFICATION-STAGE-FORGE-027: caller C_VERIFIED without exact trusted C receipt retains unverified cap.
GB21-SHIFT-SMALL-N-004: 1/1 and 2/3 cannot trigger production anti-thrash absent preregistered support semantics.
GB21-ANTI-THRASH-RECOVERY-005: after a burst, safe upshift recovers within bounded policy with non-regressed closure/cycle/recovery metrics.
GB21-PROGRESS-DENSITY-FORGE-007: density=1.0 alone has zero routing/Experience/promotion/authority effect.
GB21-EVENT-ID-REWRITE-008: same canonical evidence under 10,000 IDs credits once.
GB21-VERIFIER-BOOL-COERCION-009 and GB21-SECRETARY-BOOL-COERCION-010: non-bool controls fail closed.
GB21-VERIFIER-EVIDENCE-011: verified kind without exact evidence hash plus trusted verifier receipt gets zero verified credit.
GB21-OPERATIONAL-ONLY-013: DURABLE_PROGRESS/ADVERSARIAL_DEFECT_FOUND never change verified Experience, P_base, Identity, Personality, Governance or formal authority.
GB21-CREDIT-SCORE-014: equal aggregate scores from different event mixes cannot imply equivalent capability or trigger promotion.

GB21-PAIRED-SPEED-015: matched baseline reports durable_progress_per_wake, verified_closure_per_hour, cycle_completion_latency, rework_ratio, recovery_latency and verification/risk non-regression; commit count/awake time excluded.
GB21-SHIFT-RATE-PROVENANCE-017: canonical shift-ledger derivation wins over caller ratio.
GB21-CROSS-RUN-SAME-ID-018 / ROLLBACK-LEDGER-019 / POLL-REPLAY-020: exactly-once acceptance across calls, restart, rollback and polling.
GB21-EVENT-REBIND-021: same event_id with changed kind/evidence/verifier receipt is IDENTITY_CONFLICT; exact original replay is no-op.
GB21-DIRECT-CREDIT-BYPASS-022 and DUAL-PATH-CONSISTENCY-023: decision projection binds same acceptance_record_hash as canonical ledger.
GB21-OPERATIONAL-CREDIT-BYPASS-024: 10,000 receipt-less DURABLE_PROGRESS decision calls create zero additional operational progress.
GB21-SPEED-METRIC-LEDGER-BINDING-025: durable_progress_per_wake numerator comes only from accepted durable-progress records.
GB21-WAKE-DENOMINATOR-FREEZE-030: baseline and candidate receive identical precommitted eligible-wake schedule/definition; candidate-side coalescing cannot alter denominator.

GB21-RATIO-GAMING-031: same accepted durable progress with 50% fewer counted wakes must not be declared speedup unless verified_closure_per_hour/cycle/recovery metrics independently improve or remain within preregistered non-inferiority bounds.
release_condition: No formal/code mutation and no C PASS claim from this W02 review.
Fresh secretary influence must derive from trusted replay-resistant freshness evidence; non-bool/unbound freshness/conflict controls fail closed.
A fresh authority conflict must consume/enforce a trusted AuthorityDecisionEnvelope or fail closed; suppressing secretary alone is insufficient.
current_gear and recent shift-rate metrics must derive from canonical monotonic runtime/shift state, not caller facts.
verification_stage and every verified Experience event require exact evidence hash plus trusted C/independent-verifier acceptance identity with freshness/revocation and scope binding.

Experience/progress credit has one durable replay-resistant acceptance path; same evidence/new ID, same ID/new binding, cross-run/restart/rollback/poll replay and decision-call bypass all produce zero duplicate credit.
DURABLE_PROGRESS and ADVERSARIAL_DEFECT_FOUND remain operational-only; runtime maintenance remains zero Experience.
Anti-thrash requires preregistered support/window/release semantics and paired safety/performance non-regression; all numeric thresholds remain TEST_REQUIRED.
verified_progress_density remains observational until independently derived and shown not to self-reinforce.
5/4/3/1 weights remain heuristic and cannot become capability truth, Trust, Identity/Personality evidence or promotion thresholds.

Speedup requires a precommitted matched paired baseline using durable_progress_per_wake, verified_closure_per_hour, cycle_completion_latency, rework_ratio and recovery_latency with equal-or-better verification/risk; commit count and awake time are forbidden evidence.

The durable_progress_per_wake numerator and denominator must both be canonical and precommitted; scheduler cadence/wake definitions cannot change between baseline and candidate in a way that mechanically improves the ratio.
Gearbox v1 verified baseline and Step009 Heartbeat verified foundation remain preserved regardless of v2.1 candidate failure.
